cards.ex: We're going to ring in the New Year with friends at a big party.
cards.exUz: Biz Yangi yilni do'stlar bilan katta ziyofatda kutib olmoqchimiz.
cards.uzDef: Yangi yil boshlanishini nishonlash, ko'tarinki ruhda kutib olmoq.

cards.ex: I'm going to throw a party for my graduation.
cards.exUz: Men bitiruvim uchun bazm o'tkazmoqchiman.
cards.uzDef: Mehmonlarni taklif qilib, nishonlash uchun tadbir uyushtirmoq.

cards.ex: We should mark the occasion with a special dinner.
cards.exUz: Biz ushbu voqeani maxsus kechki ovqat bilan nishonlashimiz kerak.
cards.uzDef: Muhim voqeani, bayramni alohida tarzda nishonlash.

cards.ex: Thanksgiving is always a big family gathering at my aunt's house.
cards.exUz: Minonatdorchilik kuni har doim xolamning uyida katta oila yig'ilishi bo'ladi.
cards.uzDef: Oila a'zolarining birga yig'ilishi, ko'rishishi.

cards.ex: My grandmother passed down many cooking traditions to my mother.
cards.exUz: Buvim onamga ko'plab pishirish an'analarini meros qoldirdi.
cards.uzDef: An'analarni avloddan avlodga o'tkazmoq, o'rgatmoq.

cards.ex: Come on, join in the festivities! Let's have some fun.
cards.exUz: Qani, bayramda qatnashing! Keling, biroz vaqtni xursandchilik bilan o'tkazamiz.
cards.uzDef: Bayram tadbirlarida, o'yin-kulgu va nishonlashlarda ishtirok etmoq.

cards.ex: The holiday spirit is really in the air this year.
cards.exUz: Bu yil bayram kayfiyati chindan ham havoda sezilib turibdi.
cards.uzDef: Bayram paytida bo'ladigan xursandchilik, yaxshi kayfiyat.

cards.ex: We should protect our cultural heritage for future generations.
cards.exUz: Biz madaniy merosimizni kelajak avlodlar uchun himoya qilishimiz kerak.
cards.uzDef: Millatga tegishli bo'lgan tarixiy va madaniy qadriyatlar.

cards.ex: Everyone dresses up for the New Year's Eve party.
cards.exUz: Yangi yil oqshomi ziyofati uchun hamma chiroyli kiyinadi.
cards.uzDef: Chiroyli kiyimlar kiyish, bayramga mos liboslanish.

cards.ex: We usually get together with family on Christmas Day.
cards.exUz: Biz odatda Rojdestvo kunida oila a'zolari bilan yig'ilamiz.
cards.uzDef: Do'stlar yoki oila a'zolari bir joyga yig'ilishmoq.

cards.ex: Let's bake cookies for the Christmas party.
cards.exUz: Keling, Rojdestvo ziyofati uchun pechenye pishiramiz.
cards.uzDef: Pechda kichik shirinliklar tayyorlash.

cards.ex: We exchange gifts on Christmas morning.
cards.exUz: Biz Rojdestvo kuni ertalab sovg'alar almashamiz.
cards.uzDef: Bayramlarda bir-biriga sovg'alar berish.

cards.ex: They light fireworks at midnight on New Year's Eve.
cards.exUz: Ular Yangi yil oqshomida yarim tunda feyerverk otishadi.
cards.uzDef: Bayram munosabati bilan havoga otiladigan rangli portlashlar.

cards.ex: The village will hold a ceremony to celebrate the harvest.
cards.exUz: Qishloq hosilni nishonlash uchun marosim o'tkazadi.
cards.uzDef: Rasmiy yoki an'anaviy tadbir tashkil etmoq.

cards.ex: We observe the tradition of fasting during Ramadan.
cards.exUz: Biz Ramazon oyida ro'za tutish an'anasiga rioya qilamiz.
cards.uzDef: Qadimdan kelayotgan urf-odatlarni bajarmoq.

cards.ex: We went to the cemetery to pay our respects to my grandfather.
cards.exUz: Biz bobomga hurmat bajo keltirish uchun qabristonga bordik.
cards.uzDef: Marhumning xotirasini hurmat bilan yod etmoq.

cards.ex: After winning the competition, she became the toast of the town.
cards.exUz: Musobaqada g'alaba qozonganidan so'ng, u shaharning mashhur shaxsiga aylandi.
cards.uzDef: Hamma tomonidan maqtovga sazovor bo'lgan inson, tadbir.

cards.ex: We held a dinner in honor of his retirement.
cards.exUz: Biz uning nafaqaga chiqishi sharafiga kechki ovqat uyushtirdik.
cards.uzDef: Kimningdir yoki nimanidir sharaflash uchun.

cards.ex: It's her big day tomorrow - she's getting married!
cards.exUz: Ertaga uning muhim kuni - u turmushga chiqyapti!
cards.uzDef: Muhim voqea bo'ladigan kun, masalan to'y.

cards.ex: They made merry all night long at the festival.
cards.exUz: Ular festivalda tun bo'yi xursandchilik qilishdi.
cards.uzDef: Ko'ngil ochmoq, xursand bo'lmoq, bayram qilmoq.

cards.ex: The dance has great cultural significance in their community.
cards.exUz: Ushbu raqs ularning jamiyatida katta madaniy ahamiyatga ega.
cards.uzDef: Biror narsaning madaniyat uchun muhimligi, ahamiyati.

cards.ex: Let's raise a glass to the happy couple!
cards.exUz: Keling, baxtli juftlik sharafiga qadah ko'taraylik!
cards.uzDef: Toast aytib, sharafiga qadah ko'tarmoq.

cards.ex: We're having a family reunion this summer.
cards.exUz: Biz bu yozda oila uchrashuvini o'tkazamiz.
cards.uzDef: Oila a'zolarining uzoq vaqtdan keyin birga yig'ilishi.

cards.ex: I sent seasonal greetings to all my friends and family.
cards.exUz: Men barcha do'stlarim va oilamga mavsumiy tabriklar yubordim.
cards.uzDef: Yilning ma'lum vaqtida aytiladigan tabriklar (bayramlar bilan bog'liq).

cards.ex: She wore traditional attire for the cultural festival.
cards.exUz: U madaniy festival uchun milliy kiyim kiygan edi.
cards.uzDef: Bir millatga xos bo'lgan, an'anaviy kiyim.

cards.ex: The monument has great historical significance to the city.
cards.exUz: Yodgorlik shahar uchun katta tarixiy ahamiyatga ega.
cards.uzDef: Biror narsaning o'tmish uchun muhimligi, ahamiyati.

cards.ex: Giving gifts at Christmas is a time-honored tradition.
cards.exUz: Rojdestvoda sovg'alar berish - qadimiy an'ana.
cards.uzDef: Uzoq vaqtdan beri mavjud bo'lgan va hurmat qilinadigan an'ana.

cards.ex: When one person started clapping, the rest of the audience followed suit.
cards.exUz: Bir kishi qarsak chalishni boshlaganida, tomoshabinlarning qolgan qismi ham unga o'rnak oldi.
cards.uzDef: Boshqalarning qilgan ishini takrorlamoq, ularga ergashmoq.

cards.ex: Don't forget to blow out the candles and make a wish!
cards.exUz: Shamni o'chirishni va tilak bildirishni unutmang!
cards.uzDef: Tortdagi shamni nafas bilan o'chirmoq.

cards.ex: It's important to keep up traditions for future generations.
cards.exUz: Kelajak avlodlar uchun an'analarni saqlash muhim.
cards.uzDef: An'analarni davom ettirmoq, ularga amal qilmoq.
